minutes.headline: Historical Commission voted unanimously to impose a demolition delay on 400 Howard Street as a significant building.
minutes.summary: The Lunenburg Historical Commission met remotely by Zoom for a single item: the vote on a demolition delay for 400 Howard Street, taken up at the prior meeting. The delay was moved, seconded and approved unanimously. The chair also welcomed new member Kevin and adjourned.

votes.motion: Impose a demolition delay on the property at 400 Howard Street, found to be a significant building under one or two of the significant building criteria.

decisions.decision: The chair will advise members within the next week of the next regular meeting date.

what_happened.line: The Historical Commission voted unanimously to impose a demolition delay on 400 Howard Street, finding it a significant building.
The vote had been taken up from the prior meeting; the motion was moved, seconded and approved with no opposition.
The chair said members would be told within the next week when the next regular meeting will be held.

why_it_matters: A demolition delay gives the town a set period to look at alternatives before a building the commission has found significant can be torn down, so it bears on what may happen to this property.
